description: Full result and scorecard for one cricket match: teams, venue, date, toss, result, and for every innings the batting card (each batter's runs/balls/4s/6s/how out) and bowling card (each bowler's overs/runs/wickets). Covers Test, ODI and T20 International cricket plus the IPL (Cricsheet, ODC-BY). Use cricsheet_find_matches first to get a match_id if you don't already have one.

match_id.description: Cricsheet match id, e.g. 1082591. Get one from cricsheet_find_matches.

name: cricsheet_match
